true_answer: 72 1. Counting Bit Strings “Bit” is short for “binary digit,” so a bit string is a string of binary digits. The binary digits are simply the numbers 0 and 1. All of the following are bit strings: 1001 0 1111 1010101010 . The number of bits (0’s or 1’s) in the string is the length of the string; the strings above have lengths 4, 1, 4, and 10 respectively. We also can ask how many of the bits are 1’s. The number of 1’s in a bit string is the weight of the string; the weights of the above strings are 2, 0, 4, and 5 respectively. Bit Strings. • An n -bit string is a bit string of length n .
